item.name: The magic scroll
item.description: Parchment that carries a map of the crypt and the notes of the volunteers who came before you. It returns to the castle when its bearer dies.

item.name: Skein of white yarn
item.description: Pure white wool with a faint glow. It unspools by itself and marks the path you took.

item.name: Crystal vial
item.description: Empty, clear, and light enough to forget you are carrying it.
